reviews.author: SJ Park
reviews.summary: Reviewer noted that the patch does not address the case where memory is hot-removed, leaving a bind policy without memory, and suggested adding a check to ignore such policies.

2026-11-13.patch_summary: This patch addresses a problem where a bind policy is treated as movable-only if its nodes have no memory, leading to allocation failures and VM fault leaks. The patch ignores such policies until the nodes regain memory, preventing these issues. This fix targets systems with CPUSETS=n and HOTREMOVE=y configurations.

2026-11-14.patch_summary: This patch addresses a problem where a bind policy is treated as movable-only if its nodes have no memory, leading to allocation failures and VM fault leaks. The patch ignores such policies until the nodes regain memory, preventing these issues. This fix targets systems with CPUSETS=n and HOTREMOVE=y configurations.
